actions.title: Clear the two expired hot-work permits — or stop the work
actions.rationale: HW-4471 and HW-4468 both lapsed within the last hour and still show seven workers active on location inside the Unit 2 hazard zone. This is the highest-consequence exposure on site and it is live right now.
actions.owner: Unit 2 shift supervisor and the Unit 2 permit issuer, jointly
actions.ownerNote: Jointly, because the issuing authority is off site and the extend-or-stop decision cannot wait for a shift change.
evidence: Location trail — 7 tags inside the zone
actions.draftTask: Attend Unit 2 hydrocracker. For permits HW-4471 and HW-4468: either issue a documented extension with fresh conditions, or stop the work and clear the zone. Confirm zone occupancy is zero or permits are valid before you leave. Evidence attached.

actions.title: Confirm the Unit 3 gas test so CS-1182 stays compliant
actions.rationale: The confined-space entry on Unit 3 is compliant on every condition except one: the next gas test is due in about a minute. Two entrants are inside. Missing the interval turns a compliant permit into a breach.
actions.ownerNote: Standby attendant already has the reminder; this is the supervisory confirmation.
evidence: Gas test log — 3 readings, all within limits
actions.draftTask: Confirm the next gas test on CS-1182 is logged within the 15-minute interval. If no reading is logged within 5 minutes of the due time, stop the entry and clear the space. Evidence attached.

actions.title: Reconcile the 28 unmatched people before the shift-change muster
actions.rationale: The next muster starts from whatever headcount it inherits. Clearing the 28 exceptions now means the shift-change count starts clean and defensible — and the two with no signal at all get eyes on them before they become a muster problem.
actions.ownerNote: Two of the 28 need physical verification; the other 26 are tag-assignment housekeeping.
evidence: Exception list — 19 stale, 7 no fix, 2 no signal
actions.draftTask: Resolve the 28 held exceptions from the 06:41 reconciliation. Priority: the 2 with no signal since 06:41 near the Unit 4 boundary — send a warden for eyes-on. Then reassign or recover tags for the remaining 26. Evidence attached.
